editions.credit: Against the Heathen (Contra Gentes), in A Select Library of Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers of the Christian Church, Second Series, vol. IV: Athanasius, Select Works and Letters (American edition; ed. Philip Schaff and Henry Wace; vol. edited by Archibald Robertson), trans. Archibald Robertson (editor of the volume; the opened pages do not name the translator of this treatise individually, the Preface speaks of 'the new translations') (New York: The Christian Literature Company, 1892). Wikisource contributors, English Wikisource (Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Series II), CC BY-SA 4.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0).
